title: Inspect at a production operation
route: Quality ➔ Master Data ➔ Test Procedures ➔ Testing Combinations

tokens.v: An operation of a production order is held for Quality, tested, and released for reporting once the test passes.

achieves.text: An operation of a production order is held for Quality, tested, and released for reporting once the test passes.

tokens.v: A characteristic, such as a temperature, with its norm and limits; a test group; and a standard test procedure for them.

before.text: A characteristic, such as a temperature, with its norm and limits; a test group; and a standard test procedure for them.

tokens.v: A testing combination with origin Routing links a reference operation to a standard test procedure. Any production order with that reference operation has the operation blocked for Quality when it is released. The quantity to inspect on the operation gives the order inspection its quantity; recording the measurements passes or fails the test, and processing the inspection unblocks the operation and fills in its completed quantity.
